Name: (Out of Date) Cut Content - Bus Interior Restored
Author: UlithiumDragon
Description:
[b][size=5][color=#0080ff]Last Updated: [03/22/2017]     [/color][color=#ff0000]Current Version: [v1.1][/color][/size][/b]

Apparently there was an old planned bus interior map that was cut, but still in the files. I've restored it and used it as an interior for Pam's bus:

[img]https://u.nya.is/lywnka.gif[/img]

[b]==========================[/b]

I had to make some edits to the map:
- Removed the bus driver (that's Pam's job!).
- Flipped the map so it made sense spatially as Pam's bus (it was facing the wrong direction).
- Added in some of the never-implemented but finished animations for some of the character tiles.

[b]Also as a means to make this map a tad more useful, you can activate the driver's seat and *cough* drive yourself to the Desert if you're impatient and don't feel like waiting for Pam, or too cheap to buy a ticket. :][/b]

[img]https://u.nya.is/jutume.gif[/img]

[b]==========================[/b]

[b][size=5][u]Requirements[/u]:[/size]
[/b]
- [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/smapi-advanced-location-loader.114124]Advanced Location Loader[/url] (and [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/smapi-stardew-modding-api.108375]all of[/url] it's [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/resources/entoarox-framework.4228]requirements[/url]).

[i]*Made for [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases/tag/1.8]v1.8 of SMAPI[/url] and v1.2 of [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/resources/smapi-advanced-location-loader.3619]ALL[/url]. I will try to keep it up to date with any updates to either of those things, just know that if I don't then it might not work anymore![/i]

[b][u]This mod WILL NOT WORK with the nightly build (the v1.2 beta update). Once it is fully released I will update this mod to it, but until then this mod will only work with v1.11 ofSDV.[/u][/b]
